sections.title: Candidate privacy, data protection and hosting

questions.text: Will you sign written data-processing and confidentiality terms, suitable to the parties' roles and approved after legal review, before any CV is shared?
questions.help: A No is a knockout. Do not share real candidate CVs before written terms are approved.

questions.text: What notice do candidates receive, how do you record permission to collect and disclose their CV to us, and how can we verify it for each submission?
questions.help: Describe your process only. Do not include real candidate names or personal data.

questions.text: What role will each party have in handling candidate data, and what privacy requirements do you believe apply?
questions.help: Legal conclusions must be confirmed by qualified counsel.

questions.text: Where are CVs and related records hosted, backed up, and accessed from? Identify providers, subprocessors, and countries of storage or access.
questions.help: List locations and providers only; do not include candidate data.

questions.text: Will you disclose all storage, backup, support-access, subprocessor and transfer locations before any CV is shared?
questions.help: A No is a knockout. Non-Nepal hosting is not automatically disqualifying but must be reviewed.

questions.text: What safeguards protect candidate records (e.g. access restrictions, authentication, encryption and access logging)? Provide relevant evidence.
questions.help: Describe controls and evidence only; do not include candidate data.

questions.text: Will you provide evidence of your safeguards and allow privacy/security review before candidate CVs are shared?
questions.help: A No is a knockout. A Yes permits review; it is not itself approval of the controls.

questions.text: How do you handle suspected or confirmed data incidents, and how will you notify us and assist within an agreed timeframe?
Will you accept a contractually agreed incident-notification timeframe and cooperate with response and investigation?
questions.help: A No is a knockout.

questions.text: What are your retention periods, and how do you handle deletion from backups and subprocessors?
Will you securely return or delete candidate records on request or at contract end, including from subprocessors and backups subject to disclosed backup limits?
questions.help: A No is a knockout.

questions.text: How will you help handle candidate requests to access, correct, or delete their information?
Will you assist with candidate access, correction, and deletion requests within agreed timelines?
questions.help: A No is a knockout.

questions.text: Will you minimize candidate data and avoid collecting or sharing sensitive personal details unless necessary, authorized, and legally reviewed?
questions.help: A No is a knockout.

questions.text: Can you provide client references and sample anonymized screening notes?
questions.help: Do not provide identifiable candidate records.

questions.text: Are there conflicts of interest, subcontractors, or other third parties involved? Disclose them and explain how you manage them.
Will you disclose conflicts, subcontractors, and other third parties before any engagement?
questions.help: A No is a knockout. Disclosed arrangements are assessed, not automatically rejected.

questions.text: What other relevant policies, registrations, privacy/security evidence, or limitations should we review?
